intended_consumer_purpose: Future X0 integration may consume PostgreSQL-backed Repository Estate, Investigation Timeline, and Publication History operational projections only when those rows are faithfully bound to verified producer-issued evidence, carry preserved authority/degradation state, rebuild deterministically, and recover truthfully from backup/restore without overclaiming canonical authority or materialized-view freshness.

falsifiers_attempted.attack: Test from_ledger() with corruption_detected=true — does it return CORRUPT_SOURCE or VERIFIED?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Original X1.3 code in _materialize_publication.py: from_ledger() always returned VERIFIED even when reconstruction.corruption_detected was true. Source code: status was set unconditionally to VERIFIED regardless of corruption flag.

falsifiers_attempted.attack: Test materialize_from_projection() with empty source_evidence_digest and VERIFIED status — does it refuse?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Original X1.3 code in _materialize_repository_estate.py: materialize_from_projection() accepted inputs with empty source_evidence_digest and VERIFIED status, bypassing the producer-digest gate.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: Publication rebuild digest covers all tables
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does rebuild() call compute_multi_table_digest with named args for all three tables?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Original X1.3 code in _materialize_publication.py: compute_projection_digest() invocation passed exclude list as positional primary_key_columns argument instead of exclude_columns named argument. Only hashed one table (publication_preview_receipts) not all three.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: X0 contract bound to pushed SHA
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does candidate_commit_sha contain a valid pushed SHA or a placeholder?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Original X1.3 contract at docs/json/contracts/x0_postgres_consumer_admission.v1.json: candidate_commit_sha was a placeholder not bound to any pushed SHA.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: Canonical review cycle record present in pushed slice
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does docs/json/evidence/ contain the prepublication review cycle record?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Original X1.3 commit did not include a canonical prepublication review cycle record at docs/json/evidence/.

findings.evidence: from_ledger() always returned VERIFIED regardless of corruption_detected flag in reconstruction state. Five blocking defects missed in original X1.3 prepublication review.
findings.required_repair: Return CORRUPT_SOURCE when corruption_detected is true; return VERIFIED only when corruption_detected is false.

findings.violated_claim: Repository materializer refuses VERIFIED with empty source_evidence_digest
findings.evidence: materialize_from_projection() accepted VERIFIED inputs with empty source_evidence_digest, bypassing the producer-digest gate. Missing origin digest indistinguishable from a by-design empty one.
findings.required_repair: Refuse materialization when source_evidence_digest is empty and status is VERIFIED. Deprecate materialize_from_projection() in favour of _materialize_impl() which already has the gate.

findings.violated_claim: Publication rebuild uses multi-table named-arg digest
findings.evidence: rebuild() passed exclude list as positional primary_key_columns arg instead of exclude_columns named arg to compute_projection_digest(). Result: only hashed publication_preview_receipts, not publication_reconstruction or publication_builds.
findings.required_repair: Use compute_multi_table_digest with named arguments, hash all three publication tables with primary-key ordering, include domain_name.

findings.violated_claim: X0 contract candidate_commit_sha bound to pushed SHA
findings.evidence: X0 consumer admission contract had placeholder candidate_commit_sha, not bound to any pushed commit. Contract also implied admission language rather than candidate classification.
findings.required_repair: Bind candidate_commit_sha to e2cd4b49b (X1.3 pushed SHA). Label contract as candidate, not admission.

findings.violated_claim: Canonical review cycle record committed in pushed slice
findings.evidence: No prepublication_review_cycle record existed at docs/json/evidence/ in the X1.3 pushed commit.
findings.required_repair: Create and commit canonical review cycle record in docs/json/evidence/.

falsifiers_attempted.attack: Test from_ledger() with corruption_detected=true — does it return CORRUPT_SOURCE?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: from_ledger() returns CORRUPT_SOURCE when corruption_detected is true. Test confirms status is CORRUPT_SOURCE not VERIFIED.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: Repository materializer refuses VERIFIED with empty source_evidence_digest
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Test _materialize_impl() with VERIFIED status and empty source_evidence_digest — does it refuse?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: _materialize_impl() refuses with rows_materialized=0 when source_evidence_digest is empty and status is VERIFIED. materialize_from_projection() deprecated.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: Publication rebuild uses multi-table named-arg digest
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does rebuild() hash all three publication tables with correct named arguments?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: rebuild() invokes compute_multi_table_digest() with named arguments, hashes all three tables. Digest includes publication_preview_receipts, publication_reconstruction, publication_builds. Domain name included.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: X0 contract bound to pushed SHA and labelled candidate
falsifiers_attempted.attack: Does candidate_commit_sha match e2cd4b49b? Is contract labelled candidate not admission?
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: candidate_commit_sha bound to e2cd4b49b. Admission ID contains 'candidate'. Lane field is x1.4. Status: candidate_x0_postgres_consumer_contract, not_admitted_for_live_consumption.

falsifiers_attempted.claim: Review cycle record validates against governing schema
falsifiers_attempted.evidence: Record fails schema validation. Round 1 disposition uses 'prepublication_admitted' (not in schema enum). Rounds missing required fields (production_paths_inspected, falsifiers_attempted, findings). Extra fields present (post_review_verdict, missed_blocking_defects, repairs_applied). Builder responses missing required fields (repaired_findings, changed_paths, validation_rerun). final_admission has wrong fields. Round 2 disposition 'pending_review' not in schema enum.

findings.evidence: prepublication_review_cycle_x1_4.v1.json fails validation against docs/schemas/rig.relay.prepublication_review_cycle.v1.schema.json. Eight distinct validation failures: wrong enum values (prepublication_admitted, pending_review), missing required round fields (production_paths_inspected, falsifiers_attempted, findings), extra round properties (post_review_verdict, missed_blocking_defects, invalidated_reason, repairs_applied), builder response missing required fields (repaired_findings, changed_paths, validation_rerun), final_admission has wrong structure.
findings.required_repair: Restructure record to match schema. If schema cannot represent non-admission final_admission truthfully, make the smallest schema change required and validate both record and schema.
